interface.longDescription: Turn a written policy into rules a program can check, and get the same answer every time. A written policy becomes a formal ruleset; your model extracts the claim values; the hosted service returns each assertion's own result — TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN or AMBIGUOUS — with the rule that decided, with a counterexample when one is violated. No model in the loop: the service never calls one.
